facts.text: Gina opened an online clothing store after losing her job.

evidence.quote: I've been one 'cause I lost my job. I opened an online clothing store and it's been great!

facts.text: Gina described her experience as a leap of faith that was worth it.

evidence.quote: It was a huge jump, but totally worth it.

facts.text: Gina advised staying passionate, focused, and resilient while being open to learning and improving.

evidence.quote: My advice: stay passionate, focused and resilient. Challenges will come, but believe in yourself and keep going. And stay open to learning and improving.

facts.text: Jon acknowledged Gina's advice and mentioned he had started applying it by posting dance videos on social media.

evidence.quote: I already started doing what you said about social media and posted some of my dance videos.
